plan.goal: Build a neighbor graph from street view points using panoId, link_f_pan, and link_b_pan columns to represent connectivity relationships
plan.notes: Read the point shapefile and construct an adjacency dictionary mapping each panoId to its forward neighbor (link_f_pan) and backward neighbor (link_b_pan). Handle missing or empty link values as null. This creates the graph structure needed for path tracing.

plan.goal: Traverse the neighbor graph to extract connected paths and convert them to line geometries
plan.notes: Implement path tracing algorithm: 1) Start from unvisited point, extend forward through link_f_pan until dead-end, then extend backward through link_b_pan; 2) Collect ordered lat/lng coordinates for each path; 3) Create LineString geometry for each path; 4) Mark all visited points to avoid reprocessing. Ignore isolated points with no valid neighbors.

plan.goal: Export the line features to a shapefile with original CRS (EPSG:4326)
plan.notes: Convert the GeoJSON LineString features to a ESRI shapefile. Maintain EPSG:4326 coordinate reference system. The output shapefile contains line features representing street view traversal paths.
